title: Research: GitOps reconcilers for agent workloads (Flux on AKS and Azure Arc, Argo CD)
goal: How does GitOps with Flux v2 work on AKS and Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes, with what the microsoft.flux extension reconciles? How does Argo CD detect drift and sync an application from git under its sync policies? Which reconcilers pull desired state for Windows endpoints or Claude Code settings, if any official source names one?

gates.question: Which source carries the upstream Flux drift facts: the kustomize-controller repository's Kustomization spec at tag v1.9.6, or the fluxcd.io website page?

How does the article answer the Windows endpoints clause when no official page names a git reconciler for them: DER facts naming the nearest official pull loops (Azure Machine Configuration from Azure Policy, ansible-pull from git on a control node) plus an UNK and a gap, or the UNK and gap alone?
options: DER nearest pull loops plus UNK and gap
gates.recommendation: DER nearest pull loops plus UNK and gap
gates.answer: DER nearest pull loops plus UNK and gap

notes: How: Answer with the kb tools first and official sources for the rest, extending agents/gitops-for-agents through /kb-research.
